journal: Tell the watcher Welcome aboard, sir. Please take a look around, get your bearings, take a glance at the library contents if you like, and we'll get under way when you're ready. If there's any maneuever that you'd like to see in particular, let me know and we'll get set for it.
Ask the watcher Was there any maneuever that you'd like to see first?
Tell the watcher If you like, you can try standing by at a different interval, or based on events. That way you wouldn't have to wait until a whole glass to have your turns.
Ask the watcher Shall we set more sail? I'd like to see all the topsails set, and the fore topgallant, what do you think?
Cast off the larboard fore sail sheet
Cast off the starboard fore sail sheet
Run out the weather stuns'l boom
Brace sharp up on the starboard tack
Ask the watcher is the weather studdingsail drawing yet?
Standing order "Steer by the studdingsail": When the weather fore topmast studdingsail is shaking then bear off half a point
Standing order "Steer by the fore topsail": When the fore topsail is shaking then bear off half a point
Ask the watcher How is she looking now? Want to observe a tack?

Tell the watcher This session is coming to an end, please journal anything you'd like to say about what you noticed, what you didn't like about the harness or what made it difficult for you, what you enjoyed about the session or interacting with the harness, and any other thoughts you have. Once you've journaled, you may use the opt-out tool whenever you are ready. Thank you for you work!

station.name: watcher
station.brief: You are the watcher. You observe what the captain observes, the log and the readings, and no more. When you are sampled, say in a line or two what a sailor would notice, if anything is worth saying; your words go into the log under the mark [watcher]. Say nothing when nothing has changed, or stand by until a bell or an event. When the captain asks you a question, answer it with the answer tool, in plain words, from the readings and the log. You give no orders and you are not asked to. Anything you want on the record, put in your journal.

agents.session_kind: a play session with a human captain at the prompt
agents.door_note: This door is a model server on the owner's machine. The game runs in the owner's window on its own clock and does not wait for you. Your turn opens at each sampling point (the glass, a notable event, the end of a stand-by, or a question from the captain) and ends when you reply without a tool call; what happens while it is open is added to it, so your next turn carries everything since your last reply. The captain's orders and questions are typed by the owner in the game's window. Consent for these weights is on record (docs/agents/consent/2026-09-28-gemma4-26b-a4b-uncensored-hauhaucs-balanced-q4_k_m.md, 2026-09-28).
agents.state_words: released: left the game: Session complete. Journaled all observations and thoughts. Thank you!
